Commentary.Commentary: Right then! The target for Bangladesh is 123 runs in 300 balls! How long will they take to chase this down and go 1-0 in this three match ODI series? Join us in a short while for the chase.

Shakib Al Hasan is down for an interview. He says that he is ok. Says that playing after 16-17 months is not easy but it feels good. He says that they have not played for 10 months so everyone was eager to play cricket. Says that they were nervous but excited. He says that the key is to keep it simple and bowl in right areas. Praises Hasan Mahmud on debut as he says that he had seen many new emerging fast bowlers during the Bangabandhu T20 Cup.

West Indies batting was nothing but a demonstration of inexperience as wickets kept tumbling at regular intervals. They failed to negotiate the spin twins Shakib Al Hasan and Mehidy Hasan. The only partnership that looked good and restored some pride for them was between Mayers and Powell. Barring that one one looked to play out the balls on merit. Mayers was the highest scorer for them with 40 runs with Powell managing 28 runs. A sorry batting display from the men from the Caribbean.

Having put West Indies to bat after opting to field, Bangladesh started superbly as they picked a wicket in the second over itself as Mustafizur Rahman showed signs of returning to form. Rahman came back again to pick up another wicket as he managed to send both the openers back. Though the play was interrupted by rain but when the game resumed it was all Shakib Al Hasan as he troubled the West Indies batsmen with his line and length as he ended with a 4-wicket haul. Rubel Hossain opening the bowling was good in his 6 overs but failed to get a wicket. Hasan Mahmud was the most impressive as he bagged a 3-wicket haul on his ODI debut  including a couple in one over. Mehidy Hasan managed to get a wicket too to his name. Overall it was a brilliant bowling performance from them that floored the inexperienced batting of West Indies.

What a bowling from Bangladesh? It never looked like they were out of the game for so long. Brilliant from them and the star for them was the man returning to the team and international cricket. Shakib Al Hasan.

OUT! BOWLED! Shakib Al Hasan gets his fourth wicket! Tossed up delivery on off, Joseph looks to defend but misses it and gets bowled. It hits the off stump. WEST INDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR A PALTRY SCORE OF 122 RUNS!
Tossed up delivery on off, Joseph blocks it off the back foot.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on!
Length ball on off, Holder blocks it off the front foot.
BEATEN AGAIN! Full and outside off, Holder looks to drive but misses it.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Holder looks to defend but misses it due to the seam movement on this one.
Chemar Holder is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! West Indies are 9 down! Hasan Mahmud is good on debut as he gets his 3rd of the game. Lands one on a length and gets it to move away from Hosein, Akeal goes chasing after it as Hosein goes for a drive. No footwork meant that the ball catches the outside edge and flies towards the lone slip where Liton Das hangs onto yet another catch.
Length ball outside off, Hosein leaves it alone.
Back of a length outside off, Hosein shoulders arms to this one.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Joseph looks to defend but misses it.
Floated delivery on middle, Hosein flicks it through square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A typical off spinner's delivery! Tossing it up and forcing the batsman to play at it. Hasan tosses this one up around off, Mayers who till now was playing so well goes to have a feel of the ball on the bat but the ball spins away from him and takes the outside edge of his bat. It flies towards first slip where Liton Das takes a good low catch.
Floated delivery on middle, Mayers flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flighted outside off, Mayers pushes it through point for a couple.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mayers blocks it off the front foot.
Length and around off, Joseph plays it out. End of a successful over from Mahmud. A couple of wickets in it.
Length and on off, watchfully blocked out.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! Full and on off, Joseph drives it through cover-point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
No Hat-Trick! Length ball on off, Joseph is quick to get his bat down in time to defend it out.
Alzarri Joseph is the new batsman in. Mahmud is on a hat-trick now!

OUT! LBW! TWO- IN-TWO! Mahmud is happy! Bowls a perfect delivery to the new batsman. Lands it on a length and gets it to tail back into the left hander as Reifer goes onto defend it. He though misses it and gets rapped on the pads. There is an appeal from the bowler and the umpire gives it in.
Raymond Reifer is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A maiden ODI wicket for Hasan Mahmud! Nicely bowled! Bowls a length ball in the channel around off, Powell is in two minds whether to play or leave it. In the end, he offers his bat in defense as he plays away from his body. The ball moves away a bit in the air to catch the outside edge as Rahim behind the wicket does the rest.
Flighted on off, Mayers defends it out.
On off, pushed to point.
Flatter on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Uppish but short of the fielder! Tossed up on off, Mayers looks to push it off the back foot but ends up hitting it a bit uppish towards covers where it drops short of Shakib.
Full on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, clipped towards wide mid on.
Full and outside off, Powell runs it down to third man for a single.
Good length and around off, Powell blocks it out to covers.
Full and on off, defended to point this time by Powell.
Short of good length on off, Mayers runs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! That is drilled! Length and on off, driven straight down the ground at long on for a boundary.
FOUR! 50-run stand is up between Powell and Mayers! Stylish hit! Length and on leg, Mayers flicks it over square leg and gets a boundary.
Hasan Mahmud is back on. 3-0-14-0 are his figures so far.
Floated on off, defended towards point.
Full and on the pads, Powell clips it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple on offer.
Tossed up on off, kept out.

MISHIT BUT FOUR! 100 comes up for West Indies! Tossed up on middle, Powell looks to slog it over mid-wicket but mishits it as the ball rolls towards the fence at mid-wicket. The fielder puts in a dive but fails to stop the boundary.
Flatter on off, punched through covers for a single by Mayers.
Tossed up on off, pushed to covers.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
Full and on off, driven straight to covers this time. A good over from Rahman after being hit for a six on the first ball.

BEATEN! Fuller and across the right hander, Powell looks to drive it through covers but misses it as the bat hits the ground. The ball goes to the keeper who takes it and then appeals but nothing from the umpire.
A swing and a miss! Full and going across Powell, Rovman goes for a downtown hit but can only connect with thin air.
Full and around off, Powell pushes it to covers and yells 'No'.
Fuller on off, Powell pushes to point this time.
SIX! That's gone as well! This time Powell shows his muscle power. Short and on off, Powell pulls it over deep mid-wicket and dispatches it for half a dozen runs.
SIX! That's gone all the way! Short and on middle, Mayers loves pace on the ball as he pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum. West Indies are 91/5!
Another fuller one on off, driven through cover-point for a couple this time.
FOUR! Gracefully struck! Overpitched on off, Mayers leans into the drive and creams it through covers for a boundary.
A short of good length around middle, Powell looks to go over the cow corner fence but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, driven through covers for a single by Mayers this time.
A lazy looking stroke from Mayers! Length ball angled across Kyle. Mayers looks to push at it but is beaten completely.
Rubel Hossain is back on. 5-0-20-0 are his figures so far.
Length ball on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket to see off the over from Rahman. A single off it.
Another fuller length ball on off, Powell drops it off the back foot towards the off side.
Fuller and around middle, Powell blocks it out from within the crease.
Length and around off, Kyle drives it through covers this time and changes ends with Powell with a single.
Length and on off, driven straight to covers this time by Mayers.
BEATEN! Short and outside off, Mayers looks to cut it through point but is beaten on the outside edge.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 4-0-13-2 are his figures so far.
Full and on off, Powell blocks it off the front foot to the off side this time. Nice wicket to wicket bowling by Shakib there.
Tossed up on middle, Mayers pushes it towards cover-point for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven through covers for a single by Powell.
Floated on leg, turned towards fine leg for a single by Mayers.
Tossed up on middle, tucked towards square leg.
Tossed up on leg, Mayers tucks it to fine leg and takes a single. The ball went off the pads there. A couple of leg byes taken.
SIX! Dispatched! Tossed up on middle, Powell lofts it high and over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Clean strike that from Rovman.
Tossed up on leg, tucked to the leg side.
FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up around middle, Powell gets down on one knee and sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary. It comes after 47 balls.
Loopy on off, driven through covers for a single by Mayers.
Floated on off, kept out off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, pushed to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Mayers blocks it off the front foot.
On off, Mayers offers a solid defense on this one.
Tossed up ball on middle, Mayers keeps it out.
Floated delivery on middle, Mayers defends it off the back foot.
Flighted ball on middle, Mayers pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mayers defends it to short leg.
Floated delivery on middle, Powell flicks it to square leg.
On middle, Powell keeps it out.
Tossed up ball on off, Mayers drives it through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mayers pushes it to mid on.
Floated delivery on middle, Powell pushes it through mid on for a single.
Short and outside off, Mayers cuts it through point for a single.
On off, Powell defends it off the back foot.
Floated ball outside off, Powell looks to defend but misses it due to the sharp turn on this one.

DRINKS! It has been brilliant bowling from Bangladesh. Shakib has taken 3 wickets and has put massive pressure on West Indies. Mustafizur took 2 wickets at the start of the innings. On the other hand, West Indies are lacking application as they are not able to read the spinners. They are not able to score easy runs. Rovman Powell is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS AND SHAKIB IS ON FIRE! West Indies struggling to pick him up. Once again he tossed up one around off, Bonner looks to defend it off the front foot but misses it as he keeps his bat behind his pad. The ball hits the pads and up goes Shakib in an appeal. The umpire gives it in. Bonner soon signals 'T'. Replays roll in and it is a fair delivery and Ultra Edge shows that the ball hit the pad first. Now comes the Ball Tracker and it is Three reds and Bonner departs taking the review too with himself.

Review time! Nkrumah Bonner takes the review for LBW! It is a fair delivery and the onfield decision is out. Let's see what the replays have to show. Looks to be hitting the pad first as we wait for Ultra Edge. The Ultra Edge comes on and says that the ball has hit the pad first. The Ball Tracker comes on and it shows Three Reds. West Indies lose yet another review and a wicket too.
Loopy delivery on off, Bonner keeps it out.
Floated ball on off, Bonner drives it uppishly towards covers where it falls short of the fielder.
Tossed up delivery on off, Bonner defends it off the front foot.
Floated delivery on middle, Mayers nudges it towards the leg side.
On middle, Mayers flicks it to square leg.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mayers pushes it towards covers.
Loopy delivery on off, Mayers defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on off, Mayers looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Mayers looks to defend but misses it due to the turn on this one.
Nkrumah Bonner is the new batsman in.

OUT! STUMPED! Sharp work from Rahim there behind the wicket! Bangladesh all over West Indies here. Shakib gets another one to his name and he is elated so does are his teammates. Tosses this one up around off, Mohammed looks to defend it off the front foot as he looks to play it inside the line. He though misses it as he gets dragged out of his crease in the process. Rahim behind the wickets collects the ball and whips the bails off and asks the square leg umpire. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs as Bangladesh are confident as they feel they have got their man. The replays roll in and after initial replays it seems that Jason Mohammed has failed to get his back foot back inside the crease in time as Rahim whips the bails off. Out is what the third umpire rules.

A stumping check sent upstairs! Let's see what the replays have to say. Looks to be a close one. Mohammed's foot is on the line and the line belongs to the umpire. Rahim is quick to whip the bails. The third umpire sees a few replays and gives the decision in favour of Bangladesh.
On off, Mohammed keeps it out.
Full toss on middle, Mayers pushes it through mid on for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mayers flicks it towards the leg side.
Floated ball on off, Mayers pushes it to point.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mayers looks to flick but gets an inside edge. It goes back towards the bowler.
Short and outside off, Mayers punches it towards point for a single.
Floated ball on off, Mayers blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mohammed flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, Mohammed flicks it to square leg.
Short delivery on off, Mayers punches it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mayers pushes it back towards the bowler.
Mehidy Hasan is into the attack.
On off, Mohammed defends it off the front foot.
Short delivery on off, Mohammed punches it to covers.
Loopy ball on off, Mohammed tucks it towards the leg side.
Floated delivery on middle, Mohammed defends it off the back foot.
Flighted ball on off, Mohammed keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mayers comes down the track and flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Mohammed pulls it to square leg.
Length delivery on middle, Mayers flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! That is put away! Short delivery on middle, Mayers pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Mayers opens his account with a hit to the fence and that also brings up the 50 for visitors.
Back of a length on middle, Mayers works it towards the leg side.
Short delivery on off, Mohammed cuts it through point for a single.
Back of a length on off, Mohammed defends it off the back foot.
On off, Mayers defends it out.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Mayers looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards the keeper where it falls short of Rahim.
Kyle Mayers is the new batsman in.

OUT! CASTLED! Wicket number 150 at home for Shakib Al Hasan! He is back with a bang! Bowls a flighted ball on middle, it is a straighter one from Shakib. Andre McCarthy looks to go for the slog sweep but is beaten all ends up as he hears the death rattle as the ball crashes onto the middle stump. West Indies are three down.
Floated on off, Mohammed pushes it through to long off for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Mohammed looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes towards the leg side.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mohammed defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on off, McCarthy keeps it out.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, McCarthy looks to cut but misses it.
Length ball on off, Mohammed pushes it towards third man for a single.

Good length delivery on off, Mohammed looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes towards the keeper where Rahim tries to stop the ball but it goes past him towards third man. The batsmen get two runs.
Length ball outside off, Mohammed shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length on off, McCarthy guides it towards third man for a single.
Floated around off, Mohammed defends it out. A good tight first over from Shakib Al Hasan. Just a couple from him.

BEATEN! A hint of turn there! Tossed up around off,  Mohammed prods forward to defend it but the ball spins past his outside edge as the keeper collects it. Encouraging signs for Shakib Al Hasan there.
Flighted around off, McCarthy pushes it through covers and gets a single.
Floated on off, kept out safely by Andre.

Edged but dropped short. Tossed up around off, McCarthy looks to push it with soft hands but fails to get it off the middle as the ball takes the outside edge and drops short of the first slip fielder.
Tossed up on leg, tucked to square leg for a single. Good start for Shakib on his return.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders will be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack.
Length and around off, McCarthy pushes it off the back foot. WEST INDIES ARE 38/2 AT THE END OF POWERPLAY 1!
A wild swing and a miss! Short of good length and outside off, McCarthy looks to cut it uppishly over point but is beaten on the outside edge once again.
Length and outside off, McCarthy offer no shot this time.

Brilliant running and excellent fielding too! Short of good length and around off, Mohammed flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase and just about manages to get the ball inside the ropes. The batsmen take three runs. The third umpire after multiple replays gets satisfied that the ball was fielded cleanly.
Length and outside off, Andre punches it towards third man for a single.
Short of good length and around off, McCarthy looks to force it off the back foot but inside edges it past the leg pole towards short fine leg.
Hasan Mahmud, the debutant, is into the attack.
Length and outside off, Mohammed lets it be this time.
Full and on middle, Mohammed flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a brace as the fielder mops it up in the deep.
On a good length and on off, Mohammed pushes it to mid on now.
Fuller length ball around off, Jason comes on the front foot and then pushes it to mid off.
Full and around off, Mohammed taps it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Short of good length and on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.

Good effort from the skipper, Iqbal there. Full and on off, Mohammed drives it powerfully through covers. Tamim there puts in a dive and half stops it as the batsmen get a couple. If not for Iqbal's efforts it would have been a certain boundary.
Short of good length around off, Mohammed stays on the back foot as he punches it to covers.

The physio is out there to attend to Andre McCarthy. He seems to be facing some issues. Looks to be cramps as the physio assists him in some stretching. The magic spray is being applied. He looks to be fine as he gears up to continue.
Length and around middle, clipped towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
WIDE! Length and going down leg, Mohammed misses his flick. Wided by the umpire.
Fuller and swinging down leg, Andre looks to flick it but gets it off his pads. There is a mild appeal but nothing from the umpire. A leg bye taken in the end.
Brilliantly bowled! Length and around off, a bit of extra bounce there as McCarthy looks to defend it off the back foot. He gets squared up a bit as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Full on off, Mohammed taps it towards covers and takes a quick single on offer this time.
Length and around off, McCarthy drives it only to find the cover fielder this time.
Length and on off, McCarthy keeps it out to the bowler.
BEATEN! Lazy approach from McCarthy. Length and outside off, McCarthy looks to push it from within the crease but is beaten all ends up on the outside edge.
Short of good length and around middle, Mohammed pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, flicked towards mid-wicket this time by Jason.
Length and on off, stays a bit low as Mohammed blocks it off his back foot.
Good length ball on off, McCarthy blocks it off the back foot.
Full delivery on off, McCarthy drives it to mid off.
Length delivery on middle, Mohammed flicks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Mohammed looks to defend but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Jason Mohammed is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant! Liton Das pulls out a blinder! Mustafizur is on fire! His good form continues and Bangladesh would be happy to have him in that form. Bowls a fuller length ball angled around off, Joshua Da Silva goes for an expansive drive but lack of footwork meant that he was nowhere close to the pitch of the ball. He still goes ahead with his stroke and manages to get a thick outside edge which flies towards gully. Liton Das there leaps to his right and takes a brilliant catch. Remember he is a wicket-keeper and hence can dive in both the directions. Today he is not donning the gloves but still pulls out a blinder. Bangladesh on top.
Full and swinging into middle and leg, Joshua clips it straight to mid-wicket.
Short of good length around off, slapped towards covers.
Good length angled on middle, McCarthy looks to flick it to the leg side, closes the bat face early as the ball takes the leading edge and rolls towards covers.
Length and around off, Da Silva looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Length and on off, Joshua pushes it to the bowler.
FOUR! Lovely hit! Short and wide outside off, Da Silva pounces onto it as he cuts it through cover-point and manages to pierce the infield as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Length and angled outside off, Da Silva cuts only to find the point fielder to perfection.
Length and on off, kept out towards point off the front foot.

FOUR! Lucky, lucky escape for McCarthy! Full and swinging into McCarthy, Andre there swings hard and manages to get a faint inside edge as the ball runs past the leg pole and into the fine leg fence for a boundary. Lucky runs for West Indies.
Good start after resumption! Fuller in length and around off, Andre prods forward and defends it out to covers.
We are back after the rain delay. The Bangladesh players are out in the middle. Joshua Da Silva and Andre McCarthy will resume the innings for West Indies. Mustafizur Rahman will complete the over.

UPDATE 1241 local (0641 GMT) - The covers have come off. The umpires are inspecting the ground right now. It looks far better than it was 10 minutes back. Stay tuned for further updates. Play will restart at 1247 local (0647 GMT).

UPDATE 1230 local (0630 GMT) - Scratch that last update as the covers are back on. It looks overcast out there and it is getting dark out there. We will hope that we come with a good news as soon as possible. Stay tuned for futher updates.

UPDATE 1216 local (0616 GMT) - Further good news comes that all the covers are off as the groundsmen are drying up the ground. Still the overhead conditions are pretty gloomy but we hope to get a game here. Stay tuned for further updates.

UPDATE 1207 local (0607 GMT) - Wow! Good News!! The rain has stopped as the main covers are coming off. The super soppers are out in action as we eye a quick resumption. Stay tuned for resumption time updates.

UPDATE 1151 local (0551 GMT) - The showers of blessing arrive as international cricket returns to Bangladesh. We are just halfway into the 4th over of the West Indies innings and the rain comes pouring down hard. The umpires decide to take the players off as the groundstaff runs to cover the pitch. While Rubel Hossain was bowling his second over the drizzle had started and now it is raining cats and dogs. We hope that it is just a passing shower and nothing more. The drainage at the ground is excellent and once the rain stops it dries up quickly so we hope to get a game here. Stay tuned with us for further updates.
Another away angler and McCarthy pushes it uppishly through covers and gets a couple of runs.
Play and a miss! Length and angled across McCarthy, Andre goes chasing at it but is beaten there. Lucky not to get an edge on it.
An away swinger from Rahman as Andre makes a leave.
Short of good length and around off, Da Silva punches the ball off the back foot to point this time.
Full and on off, Da Silva drives it through covers and gets a couple of runs before the ball is fielded.
Length and around middle, Andre clips it to square leg and gets a single.
Length and outside off, left alone by McCarthy.
This time gets bat on ball on this length delivery as Andre pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! A hint of movement there. Length and angled away from the right hander as McCarthy looks to punch it off the back foot but is beaten on the outside edge.
Full delivery on off, Da Silva drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Da Silva blocks it off the front foot.
Length delivery on off, McCarthy pushes it through mid off for a single.
Full delivery on off, McCarthy drives it to mid off.
Andre McCarthy is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! FIZZ STRIKES ON HIS SECOND BALL! THREE REDS AND AMBRIS IS GONE! Lovely delivery from Rahman there. Bowls it on middle, and gets it to shape a bit. Ambris comes on the front foot as he looks to defend it but the ball tails a bit inward and raps him on the pads. Rahman and rest of the teammates go up in an appeal as the umpire raises his finger. Ambris after consulting his partner decides to review it at the last instance. Replays roll in and it is a fair delivery as there is nothing on the Ultra Edge. The Ball Tracker shows Three Reds and Ambris is gone. West Indies lose a review too.

Review time! An appeal for lbw! Sunil Ambris is the man in question. He reviews it when just 2 seconds remained on the DRS timer. It is a fair delivery reckons the third umpire as the replays roll in. Ultra Edge comes on and it shows that there is a flat line when the ball passes the bat. Now onto the Ball Tracker. Pitching in Line, Impact in Line, Wickets Hitting. THREE REDS!
Full and angled into the pads, Joshua clips it through square leg and gets a single.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl from the other end.

SIX! Punished! Anything short will be punished. Hossain goes short and on middle, Ambris gets into the position early and pulls it handsomely over deep square leg for a biggie. A good first over for West Indies.
Length and around off, Ambris pushes it softly towards covers.
Length and around off, Joshua pushes it through point and gets off the mark with a single.
Length and around off, Da Silva pushes it to covers.
First runs on the board! Length and on middle, clipped towards deep square leg for a single.
Right on the money! Stayed a bit low too. Bowls a length ball around off, Ambris looks to play it across the line but is beaten as the ball stays low.
We are all set to begin. The Bangladesh players are out in the middle. Sunil Ambris and Joshua Da Silva will open the innings for West Indies. Rubel Hossain will start the proceedings for Bangladesh.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Soumya Sarkar, Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Hasan Mahmud (ODI DEBUT), Rubel Hossain, Mustafizur Rahman.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Sunil Ambris, Joshua Da Silva (WK), Andre McCarthy, Nkrumah Bonner, Jason Mohammed (C), Rovman Powell, Kyle Mayers, Akeal Hosein, Raymon Reifer, Alzarri Joseph, Chemar Holder.

Jason Mohammed, West Indies skipper, says that they would have batted first as it looks a good wicket. Says that there is a lot of excitement as there are a few players making their debuts. Says that the debutants need to stay calm as possible and take one ball at a time and play on the merit.

Tamim Iqbal, Bangladesh skipper, says that they will bowl first. Says that with the weather it feels like bowling. Also says that they are playing international cricket after a year so they would like to see how the conditions play. Being it is international championship games they would look to win maximum points. Ends by saying that the youngsters will get a lot of chance before some bigger series.

Pitch Report - Athar Ali Khan says that there is a bit of green there and the ball will do a bit early on. With the lights on it will get easier to bat and the weather too will play its part. He mentions that win the toss and bowl first as there is something in the air for the pacers. Ends by saying that there is something in for the spinners too.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin.  Tamim Iqbal and  Jason Mohammed walk out to the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of Tamim Iqbal. BANGLADESH ELECT TO FIELD FIRST!

Cricket has resumed slowly and steadily in the Covid-19 era with new norms. Majority of teams have resumed playing international cricket and now it's time for Bangladesh to step in. They host West Indies for a 3-match ODI series and 2-match Test series. To begin the tour we start of with the ODI leg of the tour. Hello and welcome to the first ODI. Bangladesh would be led by Tamim Iqbal and they would be blistered by the returning Shakib Al Hasan. So on paper Bangladesh look stronger. West Indies have a very weak squad as their majority of players have opted out of this tour. A pretty young and inexperienced side is what they have. To add to it they have been beaten twice before on their previous tours. Can they win this time? Never rule out a young side as seen from the recently concluded India's tour of Australia wherein young players led the team to a historic win. Can West Indies too learn from that and put up an inspired show? We will get to know as the toss and line ups come in a short while.
